$comment: Foreground/background pairs checked by `ds contrast`. Colours are hex, a token name resolved from the DTCG tokens file as color.<mode>.<name> (content resolves to color.light.content and color.dark.content), or a full token path such as brand.ink.$root. kind sets the minimum: text 4.5, large 3.0, ui 3.0. Without mode, a token pair is checked in both light and dark.
